messages:
nina: Thinking aloud: proposal to surface a compact breadcrumb row that shows up to 2 levels and an expand control. Deep links should still land on full path. Figma: https://figma.com/file/compact-crumbs

omar: Sounds good. Router should be source of truth. If URL is /org/42/ws/7/models/99, crumbs expand on load to show model even if collapsed by default.

marta: A11y checklist: chevron button needs aria-expanded, crumbs need aria-current for the active item, and we should add a skip-to-content link. Also ensure focus-visible is obvious.

kevin: Mobile nuance: single-line chip + overflow popover. Popover must be keyboard focusable and not trap focus. Respect prefers-reduced-motion for any expand animation.

router-bot: Note: legacy params seen in telemetry: ?tab=overview, ?view=compact. Create router redirects: ?tab=overview -> /models/:id/overview; ?view=compact -> keep UI pref.

nina: Decision summary: 1) URLs canonicalize resources. 2) Compact crumbs default (2 levels) with expand-on-deeplink behavior. 3) Use nested paths for subviews, avoid hash fragments. 4) A11y: aria-expanded, aria-current, aria-live announcements, skip link, reduced-motion. 5) Add router redirects for known legacy params.

omar: +1, will open router tickets for redirect table.

marta: Will run screen reader and mobile checks before final sign-off.
